historical_record.description: A building contract was recorded for sewerage and plumbing work for a three-storey frame apartment building with a basement. Arthur G. Scholz was named as architect and E. Sugarman as contractor.
A permit was sought for a three-storey frame building of fifteen apartments with a basement, estimated at $50,000. Arthur G. Scholz was named as architect.

Sold for $200,000 in April 1976. The Redevelopment Agency's appraisers, Haley-Leslie Appraisal Company, cited the sale as a comparable in a Western Addition report and described a 15-unit apartment building of more than 13,000 sq ft and 42 rooms on a 5,000 sq ft corner lot.
